title: Potion Table
html:
The Potion Table, also known as Alchemy_Potion , is a leveled Treasure Table that contains healing potions, utility potions, and elixirs from Healing Potion Table, Utility Potion Table, and Elixir Table, respectively.

Drops

The following section can be transcluded into other pages with {{#lst:Potion Table|table}}.

Item Quantity Chance
Healing Potion Table 1 5/8
Utility Potion Table 1 2/8
Elixir Table 1 1/8
